image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a vintage-style wire-spoke car wheel mounted on a yellow vehicle. The wheel features numerous thin metal spokes radiating from a central chrome hub to the outer rim. A black rubber tire with visible sidewall lettering surrounds the rim. The background shows asphalt pavement and a portion of the yellow car body/fender.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The reflections on the chrome hub and the intersections of the thin wire spokes show slight 'smearing' or lack of crisp optical sharpness typical of AI generation, where complex reflective geometries often soften.
Several spokes in the lower-left quadrant appear to merge into the rim or each other without a clear mechanical anchor point, suggesting minor geometric inconsistency in the wire structure.
The white lettering on the tire sidewall is slightly warped and lacks the consistent curvature expected on a perfect cylinder, though it is legible.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific sub-type (wire-spoke wheel) and ensure it falls within the 'car wheel' taxonomy despite the non-standard hub.
Wire spokes are prone to fusion artifacts. This expert will verify if each spoke is a distinct, continuous entity connecting hub to rim.
To analyze the depth consistency of the recessed hub versus the outer rim and check for bleeding between the complex spoke geometry and the background.
To assess the realism of the complex reflections on the chrome hub, which are a common failure point for generative models.

focus_areas: Continuity of individual wire spokes (no fusion/breaks)
Physical plausibility of the central hub assembly
Sharpness of boundary between tire and rim
Consistency of reflections on chrome surfaces
